raw_fields_retained_in: build/engineering/civil-studies/first-campaign; regenerate or use archived checksummed artifacts

reference_benchmarks.applicability: Linear 2D, elastic Timoshenko sections, linear springs, smooth moving point forces; verification only.

checks.name: point load plus elastic support settlement
pier bending, shear, foundation translation and rotation

bearing.basis: Illustrative finite bearing stiffness; capacities, slip and movement ranges unresolved.

foundation.basis: Illustrative geometry for equal-scope takeoff, not site-derived dimensions or pile resistance.

ground_scenarios.basis: Uncalibrated equivalent pile-group support stiffness scenario; no axial/lateral capacity, group or settlement calibration.
ground_scenarios.name: stiffer-support

ground_scenarios.basis: Uncalibrated equivalent pile-group support stiffness scenario; no axial/lateral capacity, group or settlement calibration.
ground_scenarios.name: softer-support

mass_allowances.basis: Existing Pi reinforcement/prestress/inserts takeoff; track and rigging are explicit unverified study allowances.

material.basis: Existing elastic control; gross uncracked concrete. No measured mix or capacity model.
material.name: reference-concrete

train.basis: AW2 planning reference, equal mass and passengers per car; retained three-car, 12-axle pattern; two synchronous tracks; not Baghdad six-car loading. A 2 m triangular rail load-distribution footprint is an unverified track assumption.
train.name: LM3-AW2-planning-control
